_doc: date overrides for cases where filesystem mtime is not the right semantic. consulted by generate_file_metadata.py during the placeholder sweep, by generate_site.py for json-ld datePublished, and by validate_dates.py for honesty checks. every entry should carry a reason.

modified._doc: explicit dateModified overrides. use only when filesystem mtime is misleading (e.g. typo fix that should not bump dateModified). each override must carry a reason.

/legal/imprint/.reason: typo fix on 2026-05-09 should not bump dateModified

lastmod._doc: explicit sitemap lastmod overrides. resolution: explicit 'date' wins; literal 'edition' resolves to identity_canonical.json.edition at build time. assets excluded from file-metadata.json (the manifest excludes its own dependents to avoid cycles) must declare an override here so validate_dates.py can verify them.

/integrity.json.reason: integrity manifest excluded from file-metadata.json (would self-reference); lastmod tracks edition

/integrity.json.sig.reason: signature timestamp tracks edition, not the random gpg-armor write moment

/site-metadata.json.reason: asset_version oracle excluded from file-metadata.json (carries the bundle hash that the manifest's bytes would depend on); lastmod tracks edition

expires._doc: expiry dates for time-bound trust records. consulted by validate_dates.py.

/.well-known/security.txt.reason: RFC 9116 Expires; rotated annually with edition
